title: FM27 Logo Packs — Compatibility & Missing Badge Checks
description: Where to find FM27 logo packs, how to check compatibility and installation instructions, and what to verify when a club badge is missing in the Launch Preview.
meta: Updated 30 October 2026 · Maintainer-reported compatibility · Packs have not been installed or tested by this site.
body:
Use the pack maintainer's current instructions for FM27 logos. Our 30 October mods source check recorded sortitoutsi's notice that existing logo packs work with FM27 even when their version label still reads 2026.XX. That is a maintainer compatibility statement, not an installation test by this site.

Where to find a logo pack

Start with the sortitoutsi logo-pack library, then open the specific pack's download and installation page. Check its coverage, update date, file size, download conditions and stated FM27 support before choosing it. We link to the maintainer and do not rehost files or rank untested packs as best.

CheckWhat to establish
Game compatibilityAn explicit FM27 statement from the maintainer; an old filename alone does not settle compatibility.
CoverageThe club, competition or nation whose badge you need is actually included.
Package typeA complete pack or an update that requires an existing base installation.
ConfigurationThe supplied configuration files remain with the graphics in the structure the author specifies.
PlatformInstructions match your operating system and actual game/user-data location.

Installation checklist

The maintainer's graphics installation guide describes the graphics-folder workflow, but older edition names can remain in its examples. Resolve the actual FM27 user-data directory and follow the selected pack's current instructions rather than copying an old year literally.

  1. Read the selected pack's current installation instructions and preserve a copy of your existing graphics configuration.
  2. Distinguish the game's installation directory from its user-data directory. A real-name fix's database path is not a generic destination for logos.
  3. If the download is an update, install its required base pack first. Preserve the author's directory structure and configuration files.
  4. Follow the author's FM27-specific refresh or cache instructions. Do not assume an older edition's menu labels are unchanged.
  5. Check one club explicitly covered by the pack. Add further packs only after confirming the first change works.

No universal folder path is given here because the retrieved compatibility notice does not establish one path for every platform and custom user-data location. The selected pack's instructions determine the destination.

Why is a badge still missing?

  • The pack may not cover that club, or an update may have been installed without the base pack.
  • The archive may have been extracted with an extra nested folder or separated from its configuration files.
  • The game may use a different user-data location from the one changed.
  • The selected pack's FM27 refresh instructions may not have been applied.

Sports Interactive also warns that some club and player assets may be absent during Preview while rights-holder approval is pending. A missing official badge alone does not prove a community pack is broken. Record the game build, pack version and affected club before asking the author for help.

Logos, kits and skins are different

The compatibility statement for logos does not establish support for 3D kits or interface skins. Early FM27 skins can replace UI bundles and require different backup and installation steps. Avoid combining those instructions with a graphics-pack tutorial.
